notes: MAINT-TIMEOUT stories defined from existing ChatWindow timeout modal and AbortController behavior.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for timeout state model
Added core logic story for timeout detection and retry handling
Added UI interaction story for timeout modal actions
Added test coverage story for timeout scenarios
Added integration story for end-to-end timeout + retry flow

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S1.title: Define Timeout State Schema and UX Contract
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S1.description: Define frontend state model for long-running requests including timeout threshold, modal visibility, retry state, and aborted request flags. Establish contract for continue vs abandon behavior.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S2.title: Implement Timeout Detection and Retry Logic
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S2.description: Implement core logic using timers and AbortController to detect long-running requests (~45s), trigger timeout state, allow continuation of request, or safely abort and reset state.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S3.title: Build Timeout Modal UI and User Actions
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S3.description: Implement timeout modal with clear messaging and actions: Continue অপেক্ষing or Abandon request. Ensure proper UX state transitions and message continuity.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S4.title: Unit Tests for Timeout and Abort Scenarios
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S4.description: Create unit tests for timeout trigger timing, AbortController cancellation, retry flows, and state transitions including edge cases (rapid user actions, duplicate requests).

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S5.title: End-to-End Integration of Timeout UX Flow
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S5.description: Validate full flow from user message submission through long-running backend response, timeout modal display, user decision (continue/abandon), and final UI state consistency.
